infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Vitto uses the camera to photograph meals and scan barcodes.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Vitto reads meal photos you choose so it can grade the plate.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Vitto notices when you're walking so your pet can walk with you. Nothing is stored — it only ever looks at the last few seconds.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Vitto checks whether you're at the gym you saved so your pet can join you. Your location is never stored or sent anywhere.
